name: Google Workspace Admin Grant
description: Google Workspace super admin and other admin roles can change every mailbox, group, and security setting. Granting that role to an attacker-controlled user is the tenant takeover. They may use a quiet user that was created the same day. Password reset on the real admins often comes next. Admin-role grants should be dual-approved and alerted.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
